reason: A current spatial grid could otherwise blend unlabelled outer regions of previously separated pieces after motion. Reference-grid distance had hidden this risk.
mechanism: Committed ternary codes remove edges of the original material-neighbor graph. Whole-component IDs form a second immutable-to-contact grid key. Partial cuts retain one component and still use local cut-side codes. IDs never derive from current proximity.
qualified_domain: Regular block material-neighbor fixtures; arbitrary tomato sampling still a later gate.
model_change: No additional fracture, mass or energy changes; prevents artificial rebonding.
